bindings.caption: Adjust the Au nanosphere solution to about pH 4. Separate pH adjustment prepares polycationic particles; no acid/base identity, dose or solvent is stated. Conceptual source operation. Vessel geometry, spatial arrangement and particle shape are unassigned.

Adjust the QD solution to about pH 10. Separate pH adjustment prepares polyanionic particles; no acid/base identity, dose or solvent is stated. Conceptual source operation. Vessel geometry, spatial arrangement and particle shape are unassigned.

Add Au solution into QD solution with gentle shaking. Gold nanosphere solution is slowly added dropwise into QD solution, not the reverse. Addition rate, charge volumes and duration are not reported. Conceptual source operation. Vessel geometry, spatial arrangement and particle shape are unassigned.

Stop Au addition when pale haziness appears. Source reports relatively homogeneous coating after repetitive experiments. No purification, isolation, drying or storage step is described. Conceptual source operation. Vessel geometry, spatial arrangement and particle shape are unassigned.
